questions.question:
Which two numbers and two signs should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

18 - 6 + 11 × 5 + 18 = 113
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a9a32b421a2ac916982e27b42316e488017651877a712598c6ce719b459d00f.png] 

**Given:**

18 - 6 + 11 times 5 + 18 = 113

**(1) 6 and 5, + and **times

After interchanging the respective values and signs the equation becomes:

18 - **5 times 11** + 6 + 18 = 113

After applying BODMAS rule,

18 - 55 + 6 + 18 

42 - 55 = -13

it doesn't satisfy the equation.

**(2) 18 and 5, + and times**

After interchanging the respective values and signs the equation becomes:

5 - 6 + 11 +** 18 times 18** = 113

After applying BODMAS rule,

5 - 6 + 11 + 324

340 - 6 = 334

It doesn't satisfy the equation.

**(3) 6 and 5, - and times**

After interchanging the respective values and signs the equation becomes:

**18 times 5** + 11 - 6 + 18 = 113

After applying BODMAS rule,

90 + 11 - 6 + 18

119 - 6 = 113

**Here LHS = RHS, it satisfies the equation.**

**(4) 18 and 5, - and** times

After interchanging the respective values and signs the equation becomes:

**5 times 6** + 11 - 18 + 18 = 113

After applying BODMAS rule,

30 + 11 - 18 + 18

49 - 18 = 31

It doesn't satisfy the equation.

**Hence the correct answer is Option 3.**

questions.question:
Read the given statement and the following assumptions and decide which of the assumptions is implicit in the statement.

**Statement:**

The government decided to pay a compensation of ₹ 5 lakhs to the family members of those who were killed in the boat accident in the Godavari at Pasuvullanka.

**Assumptions:**

I. Government treasury has enough funds to fulfil the compensation expenses.

II. The government can try to bring down the incidents of boat accidents in the future in that area.

options.text: Either assumption I or II is implicit.
Neither assumption I nor II is implicit.

questions.solution:
The assumption I is implicit in the statement.

The statement mentions that the government decided to pay compensation of ₹ 5 lakhs to the family members of those who were killed in the boat accident. This decision implies that the government has enough funds to fulfill the compensation expenses, which is the assumption I.

However, there is no mention in the statement about the government's efforts to bring down the incidents of boat accidents in the future. Therefore, assumption II is not implicit in the statement.

In conclusion, only assumption I is implicit in the statement.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only assumption I is implicit**".

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows(s) from the statements

**Statements:**

All goats are black

some black are white.

No black is gold.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some goats are white

II. Some goats being gold is a possibility.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
Given Statements:

All goats are black

some black are white.

No black is gold.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/410512ff5d20ead06fa08313d643e8b84b51302425d518fefb0c0a81d6804608.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some goats are white - False (Because, No definite relation given between goats and white, so it can be possible only).

II. Some goats being gold is a possibility - False (Because, All goats are black and no black is gold, so no goats will be gold).

So, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question: Eight friends A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H, each one of them is of different height. A is taller than F but shorter than D. G is shorter than B but taller than H. E is taller than B. C is shorter than F but taller than E. Who among them is the second tallest?
questions.solution:
Given:

Eight friends A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H

1) A is taller than F but shorter than D.

D > A > F 

2) G is shorter than B but taller than H.

B > G > H

3) E is taller than B.

E > B

4) C is shorter than F but taller than E.

F > C > E 

By combining all the arrangements :

D > A > F > C > E > B > G > H

So, 'A' is the second tallest friend.

Hence, the correct answer is **'option (1)'**.

questions.question:
Select the option/number which is related to 3rd number in the same way as 2ⁿd number is related to a 1st number.

25 : 37 :: 64 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic follow here:

**1st number + (√1st number × 2 + 2) = 2nd number.**

Given:

25 : 37 → 25 + (√25 × 2 + 2)

= 25 + (5 × 2 + 2)

= 25 + 12 = 37 = 2nd number

Similarly,

64 : ?

64 : ? → 64 + (√64 × 2 + 2)

= 64 + (8 × 2 + 2)

= 64 + 18 = 82 = 2nd number

Hence, **"82"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: If 28 February 2020 was Friday, then what was the day of the week on 30 December 2015?
questions.solution:
Here, we have given a date along with the day and we need to find out the day of the next date given.

For, 28 Feb 2020 was Friday

Since, 2019, 2018, 2017 are ordinary years. All have only 1 odd day.

And, 2016 is a leap year. This will have 2 odd days.

Total days = 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 = 5.

So, 28 Feb 2016 = Friday - 5 = Sunday

Next, we will count the days of the remaining months as:

27 (Feb) + 31 (Jan) + 2 (Dec) = 60 = 8 weeks and 4 odd days.

Thus, 30 Dec 2015 was Sunday - 4 = Wednesday.

Hence, it was '__**Wednesday**__' on 30 Dec 2015.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__** Keep in mind what are leap years and ordinary year and number of odd days they have. Also, check how to find the leap year too.
